children: Piper Sandler started NVDA coverage with Overweight and a $300 price target, citing NVDA's AI compute leadership and fast product development.
NVDA fell ~2.5% to $217.97 after D-Matrix joined NVLink Fusion to link its Raptor inference chips to NVIDIA rack-scale gear; design due 2026, rack compatibility expected 2027.
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang reiterated AI infrastructure market potential of $3–4 trillion by 2030 and reaffirmed NVIDIA expects about 70% revenue growth year-over-year next year.
NVIDIA (NVDA) partners with Palantir to deploy a sovereign AI stack for supply-chain ops, integrating NeMo models, CUDA-X and cuOpt with Palantir Foundry to manage ~1.3M parts, on-prem or cloud.
NVIDIA plans integrated AI data‑center systems, citing Vera Rubin priced around $40,000 per unit versus about $25,000 for Blackwell and $18,000 for Hopper, signaling higher-priced platform sales.
NVIDIA (NVDA) expands capacity; project needs more power and water. Regulators and local communities review environmental impact and timeline for required infrastructure upgrades.
